# HubSpot Field Notes

> Step-by-step HubSpot fixes, how-tos, and gotchas by Sam Barth, a HubSpot-certified practitioner. Each article lists the subscription tier and permissions required and the date the steps were last verified in a live HubSpot portal. Independent resource, not an official HubSpot publication.

- Link builder for direct links into any HubSpot portal: https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/link-builder.html
- Request a fix: https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/request-a-fix.html

## Commerce Hub

- [Invoices from your billing tool stopped showing in HubSpot? Check Record source and Create date](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/billing-invoices-stopped-syncing/): How to tell from HubSpot alone whether a billing integration is still creating invoices, using the Invoice source, Record source, and Create date columns. (Requires All tiers with the invoices object; verified 2026-10-06)
- [Load a parts list into HubSpot products from a spreadsheet](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/bulk-create-products-from-spreadsheet/): Turning a customer's parts spreadsheet into HubSpot products: import or API, what to clean first, and the uniqueness rule products do not have. (Requires All tiers with the product library; verified 2026-10-06)

## Content Hub

- [Connect your email sending domain in HubSpot without breaking SPF](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/connect-email-sending-domain-spf/): Where to connect a sending domain, which DNS records HubSpot asks for, and the SPF rule that trips people up: one record, with HubSpot added to it. (Requires Starter, Professional, or Enterprise in Marketing, Sales, Service, or Content Hub; verified 2026-10-06)
- ['This template doesn't allow modules to be added' in HubSpot: three causes](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/template-doesnt-allow-modules/): A blank HubSpot page that will not let you add modules usually has a template problem: an empty drag and drop area, a broken extends path, or overlapping columns. (Requires Any tier with website or landing pages; verified 2026-10-03)
- [Clone a HubSpot landing page for each location: what to change every time](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/clone-landing-page-per-location/): How to clone one good HubSpot landing page for each community or location, and the four settings plus content to change on every clone. (Requires Any tier with website or landing pages; verified 2026-10-03)
- ['You have reached your page limit' in HubSpot: look at your drafts](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/starter-page-limit/): HubSpot's Starter tier limits how many landing pages you can create. Untitled drafts show up in the same list as live pages, so check them first. (Requires Starter tier; verified 2026-10-03)
- [Speed up a HubSpot landing page: measure first, then fix images and page-level code](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/speed-up-landing-page/): How to find out why a HubSpot landing page is slow with Lighthouse, then fix the usual causes: heavy images, layout shift, and extra scripts in the page's Head and Footer HTML. (Requires Any tier with landing or website pages; verified 2026-10-03)
- [Seven HubSpot theme upload errors I hit, and how to sweep for the whole class](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/theme-upload-validation-errors/): Building a HubSpot theme from scratch failed validation six times. The seven errors: reserved field names, template type suffixes, global field IDs, unsupported field types, and breakpoint names. (Requires Any account with CMS or Content Hub access; verified 2026-10-03)
- [Connect your own domain to HubSpot (and what the brand domain limit means)](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/connect-custom-domain-to-hubspot/): How to see your connected HubSpot hosting domains, what a brand domain is, the DNS record each type needs, and how SSL is turned on. Includes the one brand domain limit on a lower tier. (Requires Content Hub; the number of brand domains depends on your tier; verified 2026-10-03)
- [HubSpot approvals: require sign-off before pages, blog posts, emails, or social posts go out](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/hubspot-content-approvals/): The Approvals settings page in HubSpot: which content types can require approval, who can skip approvals, how approval permission is granted, and the tiers required. (Requires Content Hub Enterprise for pages and blog; Marketing Hub Enterprise for email and social; verified 2026-10-03)
- [HubSpot URL redirects: standard, flexible, and bulk import](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/hubspot-url-redirects/): Where URL redirects live in HubSpot, standard vs flexible pattern redirects, bulk importing redirects from a CSV, system redirects, and what cannot be redirected. (Requires All tiers with HubSpot-hosted content; verified 2026-10-03)
- [The HubSpot sitemap: what is included automatically and what is not](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/hubspot-sitemap-settings/): Where to view and edit the sitemap for a HubSpot-hosted domain, which content HubSpot adds automatically, why landing pages are not included, and how to add a page. (Requires All tiers with HubSpot-hosted content; verified 2026-10-03)
- [Your coded HubSpot template is missing from the template picker? Look under Other](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/coded-template-missing-from-picker/): The page template picker opens on your active theme. Templates that are not part of a theme only appear under Other. (Requires Any tier with pages; verified 2026-10-02)

## Data Hub

- [Connector duplicates after a company rename: sync on an ID that never changes](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/connector-id-duplicates-after-rename/): When a sync matches companies on an ID built from the company name, a rename can create a second company. How to choose a stable key in HubSpot. (Requires All tiers; custom unique value properties on any tier that has custom properties; verified 2026-10-06)
- [Same phone number, different formats: why HubSpot does not flag those duplicates](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/phone-format-duplicates/): HubSpot deduplicates contacts by email and companies by domain. Phone numbers in different formats hide duplicates until you normalize them. (Requires All tiers; phone validation rules on properties; verified 2026-10-06)
- [Why didn't this record enroll? Use HubSpot's Troubleshoot enrollment tool](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/troubleshoot-enrollment/): HubSpot workflows have a built-in tool that tests a specific record against the nine enrollment checks and tells you why it did or did not enroll. (Requires Professional or Enterprise; verified 2026-10-03)
- [Enrich HubSpot companies from a spreadsheet when names don't match: import by Record ID](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/enrich-records-record-id-import/): When company names in a spreadsheet match more than one HubSpot company, export Record IDs, match your data to them, and import with Record ID as the identifier. (Requires Any tier (property creation needs property settings access); verified 2026-10-03)
- [Two HubSpot companies share one connector ID? Merge the safe ones and hold the collisions](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/duplicate-companies-from-connector-ids/): When a sync connector keys on an external ID and two HubSpot companies carry it, data splits across both. How to triage the groups, merge the safe ones, and leave genuine ID collisions alone. (Requires Any tier (bulk merge tooling varies; API merge needs a private app); verified 2026-10-03)
- [Can HubSpot get Microsoft Teams Phone recordings and transcripts? What works and what doesn't](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/teams-phone-recordings-to-hubspot/): HubSpot logs Teams calls and syncs Teams meeting recordings, but not Teams Phone recordings. What Microsoft Graph offers, the 2026 transcript setting, HubSpot's transcripts API, and a Make versus Data Hub comparison. (Requires See the HubSpot Teams app page for requirements; the custom pipeline needs a public app; verified 2026-10-03)
- [Contact won't re-enroll in a HubSpot workflow? Check these 6 things](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/workflow-wont-re-enroll/): HubSpot enrolls a record once by default. Why re-enrollment fails, how to turn it on, and the triggers that can never re-enroll. (Requires Professional or Enterprise; verified 2026-10-02)
- [HubSpot import created duplicate contacts? Why it happens and how to fix it](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/duplicates-after-import/): HubSpot only matches imported rows by a unique identifier. Spot an import that duplicated records, clean it up, and stop it next time. (Requires Any tier (merging needs Professional); verified 2026-10-02)
